item.title: Iran War Cost Estimate Update: $11.3 Billion at Day 6, $16.5 Billion at Day 12
item.description: This update uses the DOD-reported $11.3 billion war cost to calculate the impact on munition inventories. It also estimates the cost of combat losses and damage to bases ($1.7 billion) and the total cost over 12 days of Epic Fury ($16.5 billion).

item.title: Trump May Seize Iran’s Nuclear Stockpile: Why Airstrikes Alone Aren’t Enough
item.description: Air strikes are not sufficient to neutralize Iran’s nuclear threat. Post Operation Epic Fury, President Trump is weighing options to secure the remaining stockpile, with the Department of Defense moving assets into the region to enable a potential seizure operation.

item.title: Nepal’s Election Marks a Generational Break—and a New Strategic Moment in the Himalayas
item.description: Nepal’s election signals more than a political upset. Balendra “Balen” Shah’s youth-driven victory marks a generational break in Kathmandu and could reshape how India, China, and the United States navigate a new strategic moment in the Himalayas.

item.title: The War with Iran Threatens Syria’s Recovery
item.description: Syrian interim president Ahmed al-Sharaa has a strategy for Syria's recovery. The war with Iran could jeopardize that.

item.title: How to Lose a Navy in 10 Days
item.description: The naval strikes against Iran reveal how quickly modern fleets can be crippled. Today’s maritime campaigns aim not just to sink ships, but to blind sensors, disrupt command networks, and destroy ports—often within the opening days of war.

item.title: CSIS Announces Joseph F. Dunford as Next CEO
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies today announced that retired General Joseph F. Dunford, who served as the 19th chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has been named its next chief executive officer.

item.title: What Is at Stake in Hungary’s Election?
item.description: Hungary’s April election could end Viktor Orbán’s 16-year rule as opposition leader Peter Magyar mounts a serious challenge. The outcome will shape Hungary’s democratic trajectory and impact the European Union’s unity and policy for years to come.
